ref_file_title: SV03 - A Complete Problem for Statistical Zero Knowledge
note: Journal of the ACM 50(2):196-249, 2003 (confirmed via ACM and Harvard search snippets). Preliminary version FOCS 1997; Cryptology ePrint Archive Report 2000/056 (cryptobib key EPRINT:SahVad00). ref_file_title: Sho01b - A Proposal for an ISO Standard for Public Key Encryption
note: Verified against vendor/cryptobib EPRINT:Shoup01 and search snippets (shoup.net and eprint are egress-blocked). Defines RSA-KEM (originally 'Simple RSA') and proves it IND-CCA secure in the random oracle model under the RSA assumption; basis of ISO/IEC 18033-2. Suffix b because a second Shoup 2001 paper (OAEP Reconsidered) is also cited. cryptobib_key: EPRINT:Shoup01.

ref_file_title: TY98 - On the Security of ElGamal Based Encryption
note: cryptobib: PKC:TsiYun98. WebSearch-confirmed: proves DDH ⇒ semantic security of unmodified ElGamal (messages in the subgroup), the converse, and an exact analysis of the reduction.

ref_file_title: VV84 - Efficient and Secure Pseudo-Random Number Generation
authors: Umesh V. Vazirani, Vijay V. Vazirani
note: cryptobib_key: C:VazVaz84 (verified in vendor/cryptobib); FOCS 1984 extended abstract FOCS:VazVaz84, DOI 10.1109/SFCS.1984.715948. Proves the $x^2 \bmod N$ generator secure assuming only that factoring Blum integers is hard (BBS86 assumed quadratic residuosity) and extracts $O(\log \log N)$ bits per squaring.
